name: Round Pond Mountain
summary: Steel tower above Round Pond in the Allagash area. Cab replaced in 2020; a trail guide says do not climb until notified, and a 2020 column says the cabs are open to visitors.
design: Steel tower with a replacement cab (2020), modelled on the Deboullie Mountain cab
agency: Maine Bureau of Parks and Lands

access.note: A Maine Trail Finder guide says the decommissioned tower should not be climbed until further notice. A 2020 BDN column says hikers can visit the new cabs. The sources disagree; confirm with the Bureau of Parks and Lands.

visit.trail_note: Round Pond Mountain Trail, 5.00 miles round trip; about 2.5 miles from the shore of Round Pond to the summit. Visitors pass an AWW checkpoint and pay day-use or camping fees.

events.note: Maine Forest Service panoramic map centred on the tower; a map date, not a build date
Footing and guy-line maintenance at the site; new cab built in the Ashland shop, installation planned for 2019
Maine Public Lands carried out footing and guy line work; the state also built a new cab in its Ashland shop, to be installed in 2019.
State historic preservation review list includes a fire tower platform replacement at Round Pond Mountain
New cab airlifted onto the existing steel in August 2020, part of a week's work on three towers
A new cab was airlifted onto Round Pond Mountain tower in August 2020 in the same week-long Maine Parks and Lands project.
